notes.title: Game Update: Steam Leaderboards, Trading Cards and Screen Resolution.
notes.content:
I'm happy to announce that we're updating to Version 1.03s! 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26422215/3d83e4bd24031ba28825e65f67c2c16c3a411f75.png[/img]

Major Changes 
[list]
    [*]Steam Trading Cards have been created and should be added shortly after Valve Approval
    [*]Steam Leaderboards - visit the Stats screen to upload your progress and best combo. 
    [*]Screen Resolution fixed - folks with larger screens should see a vast improvement displaying the game in full screen mode.  
[/list]

Bugfixes and Improvements 
[list]
    [*]Steam Achievement Sync - if you're disconnected from steam or playing offline, you can re-sync your achievements by visiting the achievement screen
    [*]Screen Resolution bugs - improved screen upsizing and removed the bug displaying the windows start menu when in full screen.
[/list]
